findings.text: the repair edited this file, which is outside the reviewed run's delivered FENCE SCOPE block and its own declared orientation_write_paths; the edit is the one the prior review's blocking finding required (forwarding the wrapper's whole keyword seam), but the fence granted no such path and a later reader cannot reconcile the diff against the scope.

the dry-run path reaches _raise_repository_scope_conflict with no base_revision and no stacked sink, so a dry run of a dispatch cut from a stopped holder's chain tip still reports 'refused' where the real dispatch admits it; the enclosing signature already carries base and the file's contract requires a dry run to reach the real dispatch's verdict.

refuse_widen_scope_conflicts judges added fence paths with the same check and is likewise given no base, so a stacked descendant that widens its fence onto the holder's other claimed paths is refused on the very relation the exception exists to admit; the widening run's own base_sha is on its pointer.

the table row attributes '1 failed, 4 passed, exit 1' to revision 2539356, but no log at 2539356 records it (gate-baseline-corrected.log at that revision died EXIT=124); the reading exists only as the mutation of 33be2a080 in negative-control.log, so the manifest cites the wrong revision for the arm it shows.
baseline_suite and after_suite are prose paragraphs rather than the required JSON arms, so promotion's suite-delta check reads no log_path, revision or record complete flag from them.
